title: `votingReward` not set on `Gauge`
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  The `Gauge` contract does not set the `votingReward` during its initialization and does not have a setter function for it.  As a result, when `notifyRewardAmount()` is called and fees are claimed from the pair, the transaction will revert.  ```solidity         (claimed0, claimed1) = IPair(address(lpToken)).claimFees();         (address _token0, address _token1) = IPair(address(lpToken)).tokens();         if (claimed0 > 0) {             IERC20(_token0).approve(address(votingReward), claimed0);     @>      votingReward.notify
